manual_command_policy.manual_executor_command: Manual reproduction only. Runtime dispatch uses executor_kind plus executor_inputs.
manual_command_policy.manual_integration_command: Manual integration reproduction only. Runtime dispatch uses executor_kind=run_integration plus executor_inputs.
manual_command_policy.manual_receipt_command: Manual repair receipt reproduction only. Runtime dispatch uses preflight_record_repair_edit.

task.prompt:
Execute the framework-owned integration regression.
Mode: integration.
First action: call 'run_executor' with this task contract.
Use the resulting observation to inspect only the named integration artifacts.
